headline: Argentina's Construction Jumps in September While Industry Declines
summary: Argentina's construction activity rose 7.8% from August and 5.1% year-on-year in September. Meanwhile, manufacturing grew 0.7% monthly but fell 1.8% over the past year, with ten of sixteen sectors noting annual declines.
why: Industrial and construction output metrics are key indicators of economic health, reflecting domestic demand, capital investment, and overall GDP growth trends.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Divergent industrial and construction data illustrate uneven sectoral recovery.
